mapper.select: SELECT s.material_sku_id AS sku_id, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock s JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE w.type = 'MATERIAL' AND s.owner_type = 'OWN' AND s.material_sku_id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.material_sku_id

SELECT i.id, o.id AS po_id, o.no AS po_no, o.purchase_type, o.status AS po_status, i.material_sku_id AS sku_id, o.warehouse_id, w.type AS warehouse_type, i.qty, i.received_qty, i.returned_qty, i.conversion_factor AS factor, COALESCE(i.expect_date, i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS eta, i.calc_item_id AS owner_item_id, ci.calc_id AS owner_calc_id, c.status AS owner_calc_status FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = i.calc_item_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE i.material_sku_id IN #{id} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND ((o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND i.received_qty - i.returned_qty < i.qty) OR c.status = 'CONFIRMED'
OR ci.calc_id IN #{id}
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ti ON ti.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc tc ON tc.id = ti.calc_id WHERE t.purchase_item_id = i.id AND (tc.status = 'CONFIRMED'
OR tc.id IN #{id} )))

SELECT t.id, ci.calc_id, t.calc_item_id, t.purchase_item_id AS line_id, t.qty FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE c.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ci.material_sku_id IN #{id}

SELECT ci.id, ci.calc_id, ci.material_sku_id AS sku_id, ci.use_stock_qty, ci.issued_qty FROM mrp_calc_item ci JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE c.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ci.block = 'PURCHASE' AND ci.material_sku_id IN #{id}
SELECT k.id FROM bas_material_sku k JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE k.safety_stock > 0 AND k.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY k.id
mapper.sql: WITH safety_skus AS ( SELECT k.id, k.code AS sku_code, k.safety_stock FROM bas_material_sku k JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE k.safety_stock > 0 AND k.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 ), material_lines AS ( SELECT i.id, i.material_sku_id AS sku_id, ci.calc_id AS owner_calc_id, COALESCE(c.status = 'CONFIRMED', false) AS owner_confirmed, ROUND(GREATEST(i.received_qty - i.returned_qty, 0) * i.conversion_factor, 3) AS received_stock, ROUND(GREATEST(i.qty - i.received_qty + i.returned_qty, 0) * i.conversion_factor, 3) AS remaining_stock, CASE WHEN o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') THEN ROUND(GREATEST(i.qty - i.received_qty + i.returned_qty, 0) * i.conversion_factor, 3) ELSE 0 END AS pending_stock FROM pur_order_item i JOIN safety_skus k ON k.id = i.material_sku_id JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.type = 'MATERIAL' LEFT JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = i.calc_item_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') ), active_uses AS ( SELECT t.id, ci.calc_id, t.purchase_item_id AS line_id, l.sku_id, t.qty, l.remaining_stock, SUM(t.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t.purchase_item_id) AS total_use, COALESCE(SUM(t.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t.purchase_item_id ORDER BY t.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prior_use FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id AND c.status = 'CONFIRMED' JOIN safety_skus k ON k.id = ci.material_sku_id JOIN material_lines l ON l.id = t.purchase_item_id ), allocated_uses AS ( SELECT id, calc_id, line_id, sku_id, qty, LEAST(qty, GREATEST(total_use - remaining_stock - prior_use, 0)) AS arrived FROM active_uses ), stock_contributions AS ( SELECT ci.calc_id, ci.material_sku_id AS sku_id, ci.use_stock_qty - ci.issued_qty AS qty FROM mrp_calc_item ci JOIN safety_skus k ON k.id = ci.material_sku_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE c.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ci.block = 'PURCHASE' UNION ALL SELECT calc_id, sku_id, arrived FROM allocated_uses UNION ALL SELECT owner_calc_id AS calc_id, sku_id, received_stock FROM material_lines WHERE owner_confirmed ), stock_by_calc AS ( SELECT calc_id, sku_id, GREATEST(SUM(qty), 0) AS held FROM stock_contributions GROUP BY calc_id, sku_id ), held_stock AS ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(held) AS qty FROM stock_by_calc GROUP BY sku_id ), unarrived_uses AS ( SELECT line_id, SUM(qty - arrived) AS qty FROM allocated_uses GROUP BY line_id ), transit AS ( SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(l.pending_stock) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.owner_confirmed THEN l.pending_stock ELSE LEAST(l.pending_stock, COALESCE(u.qty, 0)) END) AS held FROM material_lines l LEFT JOIN unarrived_uses u ON u.line_id = l.id GROUP BY l.sku_id ), stock AS ( SELECT s.material_sku_id AS sku_id, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock s JOIN safety_skus k ON k.id = s.material_sku_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE w.type = 'MATERIAL' AND s.owner_type = 'OWN' GROUP BY s.material_sku_id ), reorder_balances AS ( SELECT k.id AS material_sku_id, k.sku_code, ROUND(COALESCE(s.qty, 0), 3) AS stock_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(t.qty, 0), 3) AS transit_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(h.qty, 0) + COALESCE(t.held, 0), 3) AS held_qty, ROUND(k.safety_stock, 3) AS safety_stock, ROUND(k.safety_stock - (COALESCE(s.qty, 0) + COALESCE(t.qty, 0) - COALESCE(h.qty, 0) - COALESCE(t.held, 0)), 3) AS gap_qty FROM safety_skus k LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.sku_id = k.id LEFT JOIN transit t ON t.sku_id = k.id LEFT JOIN held_stock h ON h.sku_id = k.id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reorder_balances WHERE gap_qty > 0

SELECT material_sku_id, stock_qty, transit_qty, held_qty, safety_stock, gap_qty FROM reorder_balances WHERE gap_qty > 0 ORDER BY gap_qty DESC, sku_code, material_sku_id LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(#{limit}, 1), 100) OFFSET GREATEST(#{offset}, 0)
